responsibility: Serves as the root of the `rustc_borrowck` crate and orchestrates MIR borrow checking for the `mir_borrowck` query. It wires the crate’s submodules together, provides the query provider, drives the end-to-end borrow-checking pipeline from MIR preparation through NLL region inference, dataflow, diagnostics, and result assembly, and contains shared top-level borrowck types and diagnostic buffering used across the crate.
